The FVRD's Hemlock Valley Official Community Plan (OCP) governs the plan area and the FVRD administers it.
That resort is now Sasquatch Mountain Resort.
The nearest town is Agassiz, in the District of Kent, about 38 kilometres away by the OCP's measure. Mission is about 55 kilometres west — a reporting grouping, not the government here.
House streets named in the OCP area include Sakwi Creek Road, Edelweiss Drive and Snowmist Place. Village roads and resort streets, not Mission city streets.

Detached cabins and chalets are the house stock in a small resort village of about 200 dwellings. The FVRD evacuation guide describes those dwellings as mainly vacation homes and short-term rentals, with the resort at the village's upper end. Evacuation Guide - Hemlock Valley.pdf
The OCP counted 226 resort residential units, equal to 1,072 bed units, in the existing base.
The OCP splits the village into Hemlock West, Hemlock East and Hemlock North planning areas. Each is to be detailed through a neighbourhood plan as the resort expands.

blocks.text: Hemlock Houses: rules that affect buyers

items.t: FVRD bylaws, not Mission bylaws, set the land rules for a Hemlock house. The current OCP is FVRD Bylaw No. 1626, 2021, for Hemlock Valley in a portion of Electoral Area C, adopted March 17, 2022.
Development Permit Areas in the OCP include protection of development from hazardous conditions. Confirm a lot's permit-area status with the FVRD before valuing a slope lot.

Rental use is the village pattern, not a guarantee for any one house. Parcel-level rental permission, strata rules and licensing still need confirmation for the specific property. Evacuation Guide - Hemlock Valley.pdf

blocks.text: Hemlock Houses: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: The Hemlock Valley Homeowners Association was established in 1980 and works for valley homeowners. The OCP records it as a non-profit.

Water, sewer and other services here are resort-community systems, not City of Mission services. The OCP's services chapter covers water supply, sanitary sewer, utilities, stormwater, snow clearing and solid waste for the plan area.
Confirm the provider, the bill and any upgrade charges for the specific lot before removing subjects.
The ski hill recorded in the OCP has 4 lifts and 146.8 hectares of developed terrain on 35 named trails. It uses a 100 percent natural snowpack, on the south and southwest slopes.

blocks.text: Hemlock Houses: development and new projects

items.t: Named once: the provincially approved Resort Master Plan vision toward 19,969 bed units at full build-out, a long-range plan, not built homes.

Hemlock Valley OCP, FVRD Bylaw No. 1626, 2021, Electoral Area C. Status: adopted March 17, 2022, replacing Bylaw No. 0030, 2000 (as of November 3, 2026). This is the house-specific plan in force for every Hemlock lot, so it is carried in full here.
A Hemlock house pays provincial rural tax, not a Mission municipal rate. The Province states rural-area owners receive the notice from the Surveyor of Taxes Office and pay the Province.
Rural taxes are due July 2, with penalties for late payment under the Taxation (Rural Area) Act.

The Speculation and Vacancy Tax does not list FVRD Electoral Area C as a taxable area. The Province's taxable-area list names municipalities such as the City of Delta and the District of Mission, not Hemlock Valley's rural area — check the Province map for the lot.

The valley is reached by road from the Agassiz and Harrison Mills side, with no public transit confirmed. The FVRD evacuation route runs past Sts'ailes First Nation, Harrison Mills and sites along that route. Evacuation Guide - Hemlock Valley.pdf
Agassiz is the service town for a Hemlock house, about 38 kilometres away per the OCP. Everyday trips for school, medical care and shopping start with that road trip.

blocks.text: Hemlock Houses: risks and due diligence

items.t: Check the OCP hazard chapter and permit areas for the lot before offering. The OCP carries a Wildfire Interface Hazard section and Development Permit Areas for hazardous conditions.
Check the FVRD evacuation guide for the lot's route and assembly information. Hemlock Valley is a designated place in FVRD Area C with its own guide. Evacuation Guide - Hemlock Valley.pdf
Confirm water, sewer and road service for the lot in writing.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Hemlock?

faq.a: No, Hemlock Valley is not inside the City of Mission, even though board reporting groups it under Mission. Title, permits and taxes run through the FVRD and the Province, so do not apply Mission bylaws or Mission tax rates to a Hemlock purchase.
faq.q: Is a Hemlock house in Mission?

faq.a: You pay the Province, not a city, because Hemlock Valley is a rural area. The Province states a rural-area owner gets the tax notice from the Surveyor of Taxes Office and pays the Province, not the regional district. That is different from a Mission house, where the city collects the tax.
faq.q: Who do I pay property tax to?

faq.a: There is no school in the valley, so children travel out for school. The OCP states the small permanent population limits the viability of a school inside the Controlled Recreation Area.
faq.q: Where do children go to school?
